title: Sending a link from Windows Phone to Chrome
intro: SendToChrome paired a Windows Phone with a desktop browser so a link sent from the phone would open in a new tab.
paragraphs: The 2015 project contains a Windows Phone app, a Chrome extension and a web API.
The phone requested a pairing code from the API. You entered that code in the Chrome extension and named the browser. The phone could then list its paired browsers and send a URL to one of them.
The extension received the URL through Google Cloud Messaging and opened it in a new tab.
